# Load PCA results

```{r}
target_cat <- "painting"
feature_model <- "vgg"

full_df <- fread(file.path(bob_ross_path, paste0("pca_combined_", feature_model, "_test2.csv"))) %>% 
  as.data.frame()
full_df$release_date <- as.Date(full_df$release_date)

years <- full_df$year %>% unique()
```


# Movement characterization

## Fixed coarse-graining

```{r movement analysis}
# daily level movements
d_ordered_pca <- full_df %>% 
  select(contains("_pc"))

bobr_mvt <- ordinal_movement(d_ordered_pca)
d_step_sizes <- bobr_mvt[[1]]
d_cos_sims <- bobr_mvt[[2]]

dstep_plot <- qplot(d_step_sizes, bins = 100) +
  xlim(c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "daily-level step size") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())

# ggsave(paste0("img/cstep_size_dist_", feature_model, ".png"))

# Visualizing cosine similarity
csd_plot <- qplot(d_cos_sims, bins = 100) +
  xlim(c(-1, 1)) +
  xlab("cosine similarity") +
  labs(title = "daily-level directional change") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())

dstep_plot

csd_plot
```

# Sliding windows analyses

```{r}
ordered_df <- full_df %>% 
  arrange(release_date) %>% 
  select(release_date, low_pc1:high_pc100)

# centering embeddings
# alternatively, mutate_each(funs(.-mean(.)), contains("_pc"))
ordered_df[2:201] <- ordered_df[2:201]-colMeans(ordered_df[2:201])[col(ordered_df[2:201])]

# aggregate the embedding by date
agg_pca <- ordered_df %>% 
  group_by(release_date) %>% 
  summarize(across(contains("_pc"), mean)) %>% 
  rename(target_date = release_date)

year_window <- 5 # c(1:70)

first_date <- ymd(19830111)
last_date <- ymd(19940517)

# (last_date - first_date) / 365

window_size <- years(year_window)
wstep_size <- 1
wstep_unit <- "years"

slidw_df <- sliding_window_mvt(agg_pca, first_date, last_date,
                               window_size, wstep_size, wstep_unit)
slidw_df

write_csv(slidw_df,
          file.path("results",
                    paste0("slide_br", year_window, "y_", feature_model, 
                           "_burst1y_3_test2.csv")))
```


# Visualizing results

```{r}
# slidw_df <- read_csv(file.path("results",
#                                "slide_br5y_burst1y_3.csv"))


cstep_slidw_plot <- slidw_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = start_date, y = cstep_avg)) +
  geom_line() +
  # geom_line(aes(y = cstep_pred), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  xlab("time (year)") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = expression("Stylistic Change, "*Delta*"("*s[t]*","*s[t+1]*")"),
                     limits = c(0.1, 0.5)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title=element_text(size=14))


# Stylistic dimensionality

dim_slidw_plot <- slidw_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=start_date, y=dim90)) +
  geom_line() +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = ymd("1900-08-01"), color = "red") +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_smooth(method="lm") +
  ylim(4, 34) +
  xlab("time (year)") +
  ylab("Style Manifold Dimensionality") +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size=14))

pratio_slidw_plot <- slidw_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=start_date, y=pratio)) +
  geom_line() +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = ymd("1900-08-01"), color = "red") +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_smooth(method="lm") +
  xlab("time (year)") +
  ylab("Style Manifold Dimensionality") +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size=14))



slidw_df <- slidw_df %>% 
  mutate(rescaled_loc_burst = (loc_burst + 1) / 2)

# slidw_df$adjust_burst[is.infinite(slidw_df$adjust_burst)] <- NA

slidw_df %>% 
  summarize(avg_loc_burst = mean(rescaled_loc_burst, na.rm = T))

histburst_plot <- slidw_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=loc_burst)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(name="Burstiness", limits=c(-1,1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  ylab("frequency") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size=14))



plot_grid(cstep_slidw_plot, pratio_slidw_plot, histburst_plot,
          ncol = 1)

ggsave("img/bobross_mvt_test2.jpeg", width = 10, height = 10)
```
